docs.title: Overview
docs.body:
Personas is a small Markdown layer for the people Tool Share is designed for, written in more depth than Vision's one-line personas, plus loose notes on improvements.

**Start here:** [Charter](#doc/charter), then [Personas](#node/people) for the required format.

docs.title: Charter
docs.body:
## Purpose

Keep a full portrait of each person we design for, grounded in interviews, so pages and flows are written for real people.

## Contents and scope

One document per persona, and a folder of improvement notes. Product goals stay in Vision.

docs.title: Files
docs.body:
A Markdown editor over the layer's files, with a folder tree.

**Edits:** [Personas](#node/people), [Notes](#node/notes).

information.title: Personas
information.intent: One document per person we design for, in the required format below.
information.body: Each file in `personas/` describes one persona. The file name is the persona's key (`borrower.md`). Other layers may refer to a persona by that key.

shape.format:
# {Name}

> {One line: their situation}

## Needs
- …

## Frustrations
- …

## Evidence
- Interview or source, with date

information.title: Notes
information.intent: Loose notes on app improvements, any number, any form.
information.body: Unstructured. Agents may read these for ideas but should not treat them as decisions.
